logo.rules: Never recolor, stretch or put on a busy background. Keep at least 0.25x its width clear around it.

signature_shape.description: One solid band rotated -9 degrees that crosses the frame edge to edge
signature_shape.title_card: Black background, red band across the bottom
signature_shape.category_card: Red background, black band across the top
signature_shape.end_card: Black background, red band across the top

title_card.layout: Logo left at 25% width; text block right: '2027 FINE ARTS' label, 'EXPLAINER SERIES' title on two lines, 'WHAT TO EXPECT · HOW TO WIN' in light gray

category_card.layout: Label 'VIDEO 0N · GROUP' top left in white on the black band; big white title; spaced subtitle under it; small logo bottom right
category_card.title_size_px: up to 230, shrink to fit 75% of width

info_card.layout: Black background, 32 px red bar on the left edge, red spaced label, big white title, subtitle items as white chips (newest or key item as a red chip)

checklist.full: White background, black header bar with spaced white title, rows with a red square check and bold black text; unchecked rows at 40% opacity
checklist.side_panel: Same look shrunk to the right third of the frame (about 600 px wide) over the speaker shot, 90% opaque white

rule_popup.layout: White box top right, 4 px radius, red text weight 800 at ~72 px, optional black caption weight 600 under it

name_bars.layout: Bottom left: 44 px red strip then black box with white name (weight 700) and light gray 'GRADE · SCHOOL' line

end_card.layout: Centered logo, 'QUESTIONS?' title, 'SoCalClassicFA@gmail.com', 'FEB 24–26, 2027 · PACIFIC BAPTIST SCHOOL' in light gray

captions.layout: Bottom center, max 2 lines, white Poppins 600 at 44 px on a 70% black box; speaker tag 'P1' or 'P2' as a small red chip at the left of the box
captions.note: Captions are for the animatic only, standing in for the voice track

motion.cuts: Hard cuts between camera shots; red band wipe into full-screen graphics; 12-frame cross-dissolve into the end card; 8-frame fade from black at the very start
